environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/154.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

notes: Loopback production build with a test-only passive probe; no CPU or network throttling.
rAF cadence is a main-thread scheduling proxy, not measured GPU/rendered FPS.
Zero transfer size can indicate a cache hit or restricted timing information.
Probe module requests are excluded from the resource totals.
Navigation, LCP and CLS belong to the initial document, not each subsequently opened overlay.
The probe adds a rAF callback and publishes this hidden output once per second.
All browser interactions were UI actions; final resize tests used the final production build.
Candidate captures preceded the final pointerdown cancellation safeguard. Final captures were made after a fresh load of the final build.
The candidate contact-small-phone screenshot includes a menu transition; use final-contact-small-phone for settled visual evidence.
QA environment controls simulate JavaScript matchMedia and visibilitychange behavior only; they do not emulate OS CSS media queries, actual tab scheduling, a touch device, or a real phone.
Raw LCP and CLS after a viewport resize or SPA navigation are not clean page-load metrics.
